_doc: What the player sees when they click an object (scripts/ui/pie_entries.gd, pie_menu.gd). Unavailable actions are never listed (the menu is for what you can do now); at most `max_flat` actions are shown at once, the rest sit in a few named groups that open on a click. Per object definition: hide = actions that are never offered here (patterns end in * for a prefix; they live in a window of their own, e.g. the Council window), groups = named groups {name: [ids or prefix*]}, first = the main actions shown first, in this order.
